sources.label: Standalone, app-specific patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: kveld9 Extra
patch_list: Hides hardware IDs and lets Bluetooth work without location.
Fully disconnects the app from the internet. Pair your earbuds first.
Lets the app run on rooted phones and network tools without crashing.
Blocks unencrypted traffic and disables certificate pinning.
Shows every earbud model for pairing.
Skips startup agreements, tutorials, and promo banners.
Stops persistent notifications and background battery drain.
Enables full features on Samsung, Pixel, and other non-Xiaomi phones.
Enables spatial audio and hearing features on all devices.
Lets guests check and install earbud firmware updates.
